The '''mother''' of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]]<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> lived with her [[Keyan Farlander's father|partner]], son<ref name="EGPM" /> and daughter [[Kitha Farlander|Kitha]]<ref name="OSG" /> on the family's [[mugruebe]] [[Farm/Legends|ranch]]<ref name="EGPM" /> in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Tondatha]] on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial period]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Tondatha was [[Destruction of Tondatha|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in retaliation for alleged sedition by its residents.<ref name="OSG" />
